models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Represents an authenticated member who can manage personal todo items.

This model defines the identity of users who have completed registration and authentication. It stores the necessary attributes to uniquely identify and authenticate a member, enabling them to create, view, update, and delete their own todo items. This table is distinct from todo_list_guest and represents the primary actor with full access to the todo system.

Relationships: Each todo_list_users is the owner of zero or more todo_list_todos via the userId foreign key.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: The unique email address used for authentication and identification. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the user account was logically deleted, marking it as inactive. Null if account is still active.

models.name: todo_list_guest
models.description:
Represents an unauthenticated visitor who is initiating registration.

This model captures the identity of guests attempting to register for the application. It ensures each registration attempt is tracked and prevents duplicate registration by email. This table is essential for securely capturing registration data before user account activation and is distinct from todo_list_users, which represents fully authenticated members.

Relationships: A todo_list_guest may later become a todo_list_users after email verification. It may also be referenced by audit systems logging registration attempts.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: The email address provided during guest registration. Used to send verification email and prevent duplicate registrations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the guest registration attempt was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the guest record was last updated (e.g., verification link resent).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the guest registration attempt was canceled or expired. Null if still active.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Personal task items owned by authenticated users.

Stores individual to-do items that users create to manage their personal tasks. Each item is owned by exactly one user and has a lifecycle independent of other entities. Items can be marked as completed or remain pending, with timestamps tracking creation and modification. This table enforces strict data ownership - no user can access, modify, or delete another user's todos.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_users_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this todo item. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The title or description of the task. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character and cannot exceed 200 characters.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Whether the task has been marked as completed. Default value is false.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the todo item was created. Set to current server time at creation and never modified.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the todo item was last updated (title changed or status toggled). Updated on every modification.
